?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:8678
Court No. - 76
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 13539 of 2023
Applicant :- Sunil Kumar Tripathi

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Ashutosh Pandey

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed on behalf of the applicant in Court today is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Ashutosh Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Rajeev Dhar Dwivedi,
learned A.G.A. for the State.

3. The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in F.I.R./Case Crime No.159 of 2023, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B IPC, Police Station Industrial Area, District Prayagraj, with a prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail.

4. FIR of the present case was lodged on 29.07.2023 against one Shiv Prasad and as per allegation,
the nominated accused by playing fraud executed a sale-deed of the property of the maternal uncle of the informant, who had already died.

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is an advocate and he earlier moved a complaint against the police officer and only due to this reason during investigation, he has been made accused in the present matter.
6.

He further submits that as per allegation, applicant helped the nominated accused Shiv Prasad and provided him fake document of late Bhagirathi, the maternal uncle of the informant but there is no evidence in this regard on record.

7. He further submits that applicant is not having any previous criminal history to his credit and if he will not enlarge on anticipatory bail then his entire professional career will be ruined as local police is continuously trying to arrest him.

8. Per contra, learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail but could not dispute the fact that applicant was not named in the FIR and he is an advocate and except the statement of the accused and bald allegation that he prepared the fake document and provided the same to the nominated accused Shiv Prasad, there is no other evidence till date against him on record.
He further could not dispute the fact that applicant is not having any previous criminal history to his credit.
9. I have heard both the parties and perused the record of the case.

10. Considering the fact that name of the applicant was disclosed during investigation and except the bald allegation that he also involved in the present fraud alongwith nominated accused Shiv Prasad, there is no other evidence against him and he is an advocate and is not having any criminal history to his credit, in my view applicant is entitled to be released on anticipatory bail till conclusion of trial.
11. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant anticipatory bail application is allowed.

sentences.text: 13. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall have the liberty to cancel the bail granted to the applicant.

14. It is made clear that observations made in granting anticipatory bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion based on the testimony of the witnesses.
